# Weaving Designs - Premium Embroidery & Jacquard Marketplace

Weaving Designs is a digital storefront where creators and businesses can search, preview, and download premium Jacquard weaving patterns and custom embroidery files.

## Primary Routes

- [Homepage Catalog](https://www.weavingdesigns.in/) - Browse and filter premium patterns by hook configurations, reed specs, and borders.
- [Shopping Cart](https://www.weavingdesigns.in/cart) - Manage the selected embroidery files before secure payment.
- [Checkout Portal](https://www.weavingdesigns.in/checkout) - Purchase patterns securely using UPI credentials.
- [Downloads Portal](https://www.weavingdesigns.in/downloads) - Access and retrieve purchased zip files using your billing email.
- [Support Email](mailto:gudurupavan0297@gmail.com) - Direct contact point for custom order queries and technical help.

## Technical Scope

This marketplace delivers high-resolution production files in industry-standard machine formats:
- **Formats**: DST, PES, EXP, HUS, JEF, XXX, BMP, and custom CAD configurations.
- **Specifications**: Explicit stitch counts, needle/color maps, and dimensions are provided for all files.
